title: Zynthian OSC feedback source ports
problem: Multiple OSC mixer controllers on one host cannot receive independent feedback because Zynthian identifies clients by host and sends every update to UDP port 1370.
reproduce: Register two OSC clients at 127.0.0.1 with different source ports, emit a fader update, remove one endpoint, then emit a balance update.
acceptance: Both registered endpoints receive the first update on their own ports; removing one host-port pair leaves the other endpoint active and receiving updates.
repair: Carry the heartbeat source port through the GUI registry, Python wrapper and native mixer endpoint table, and remove clients by the full host-port pair.

verification.limitations: The loopback test exercises the patched native OSC sender and exact UDP destinations with JACK replaced by a build stub. It does not run the complete Zynthian UI or verify a physical Zynthian.
verification.ownerCheck: Run the candidate on an Oram device; start two Open Stage Control instances on one host with different --osc-port values; send heartbeat to Zynthian; confirm both receive fader, mute and DPM feedback; let one heartbeat expire and confirm the other continues receiving updates.
